# Ogg/Opus File

## Summary
The audio specialization for Ogg containers, including Opus and Vorbis.
An instance is an uploaded realm file with card semantics: the binary lives at
the file URL while the card carries extracted metadata and renders with
format-aware templates.

## Shape
Extends `AudioDef`. Adds no fields of its own — `duration`, `encoding`, `tags` and waveform metadata come
from `AudioDef`. It supplies the extraction pass: walking Ogg pages to the
identification header, then reading tags from the Vorbis comment block, which
is the format both Opus and Vorbis share.

Accepts: `.ogg, .oga, .opus, audio/ogg, audio/opus`

## Example
```ts
import { OggDef } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/ogg-audio-def';

@field attachment = linksTo(OggDef);
```
Instances are created by upload (`createFileDef` wires the type from the
MIME type). Live examples need uploaded fixtures — `Spec` has no field that
accepts a file today (`linkedExamples` is `linksToMany(CardDef)`, and
`FileDef` is a sibling of `CardDef`), so the example check stays open for
every file def until `fileExamples` lands.
